In this position you will serve as a first line supervisor over a team of Program Managers who are engaged in managing critical program segments for which the scope and effect of the work have an Office of Field Operations-wide impact.

You will oversee a variety of law enforcement programs, to include enforcement operations for drug interdiction and seized narcotics accountability. This position starts at a salary of $143,913.00 (GS-14, Step 1) to $187,093.00 (GS-14, Step 10).

Typical duties include: Planning, organizing, coordinating, controlling, and evaluating the activities of an organization(s) Overseeing the overall planning, direction, and timely execution of a program or several program segments, each of which is managed through separate subordinate organizational units Leading complex projects, often cutting across organizational/activity lines, defining critical quality factors and process improvements Assuring implementation by subordinate organizations and operating units of the goals and objectives of a CBP-wide program Determining goals and objectives that need additional emphasis; developing measures that evaluate performance; making recommendations for program improvement; and managing all resources as corporate assets GS Salary: Visit this link to view the locality pay tables by geographic area.

If you do not see your geographic area listed, select the "Rest of United States" pay table. Some positions fall under a special pay rate depending on the series, grade level and location of the position. Please visit this link to view special pay rate charts.
Experience: You qualify for the GS-14 grade level if you possess 1 year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, performing duties such as: Planning, directing, and evaluating major program segments that include diverse professional, technical, and administrative activities, with impact across a headquarters-level office or nationwide program, including development and execution of multi-year work plans and goals.

Leading complex, cross-organizational projects as a subject matter expert, including applying analytical methodologies (such as statistical tools, mathematical techniques, and process mapping) to improve service delivery, reduce costs, increase quality, and develop and justify business cases.

Providing technical direction in project management, team building, facilitation, process improvement analysis, and the methodology required to develop and substantiate a business case for the selected project.

Overseeing law enforcement-related programs such as inspection, intelligence analysis, drug interdiction, and seized property accountability, including ensuring enforcement of applicable laws and policies, overseeing enforcement actions, and ensuring proper custody, preservation, and disposition of contraband and seized property.

Managing organizational change and resources, including approving allocation and distribution of funds, implementing internal controls in accordance with the Federal Managers' Integrity Act, identifying and resolving issues where no policy exists, and coordinating with senior officials within and outside the agency to address complex, cross-cutting program issues.

NOTE: Your resume must explicitly indicate how you meet this requirement, otherwise you will be found ineligible. Please see the "Required Documents" section below for additional resume requirements.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

You must: Meet all qualification requirements, including education if applicable to this position, subject to verification at any stage of the application process; and Meet all applicable Time in Grade requirements (current federal employees must have served 52 weeks at the next lower grade or equivalent grade band in the federal service) by 08/12/2026.

The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) must authorize employment offers made to current or former political appointees.

If you are currently, or have been within the last 5 years, a political Schedule A, Schedule C, Non-career SES or Presidential Appointee employee in the Executive Branch, you must disclose this information to the Human Resources Office. Background Investigation: U.S.

Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is a federal law enforcement agency that requires all applicants to undergo a thorough background investigation prior to employment in order to promote the agency's core values of vigilance, service to country, and integrity.

During the screening and/or background investigation process, you will be asked questions regarding any felony criminal convictions or current felony charges, the use of illegal drugs (e.g., marijuana, cocaine, heroin, LSD, methamphetamines, ecstasy), and the use of non-prescribed controlled substances including any experimentation, possession, sale, receipt, manufacture, cultivation, production, transfer, shipping, trafficking, or distribution of controlled substances.

For additional information on the preemployment process, review the following link: Applicant Resources | CBP Careers Residency: There is a residency requirement for all applicants not currently employed by CBP.

Individuals are required to have physically resided in the United States or its protectorates (as declared under international law) for at least three of the last five years.

If you do not meet the residency requirement and you have been physically located in a foreign location for more than two of the last five years, you may request an exception to determine if you are eligible for a residency waiver by meeting one or more of the following conditions: Working for the U.S.

Government as a federal civilian or as a member of the military A dependent who was authorized to accompany a federal civilian or member of the military who was working for the U.S. government Participation in a study abroad program sponsored by a U.S. affiliated college or university Working as a contractor, intern, consultant or volunteer supporting the U.S. government Probationary Period: All employees new to the federal government must serve a one year probationary period during the first year of his/her initial permanent federal appointment to determine fitness for continued employment.

Current and former federal employees may be required to serve or complete a probationary period. Agency Career Transition Assistance Program (CTAP) Eligibles: If you have never worked for the federal government, you are not CTAP eligible. View information about CTAP eligibility on OPM's Career Transition Resources website.

Advising leadership on IT modernization, AI adoption, and policy alignment, and ensuring compliance with OMB directives, federal IT policy, and data governance standards Managing cross-functional teams and contractors delivering complex IT systems
You must meet the qualification (experience and/or education) requirements by the closing date of this announcement. To view the eligibility and qualification requirements of an IT PROJECT MANAGER, GS-2210, please visit: IT Project Manager, 2210. Specialized experience is defined as: Experience leading enterprise portfolio management, executing enterprise-level initiatives leveraging agile methodologies, and management of cross functional teams. Experience also includes establishing governance frameworks, policies, and performance metrics for enterprise-level IT and AI projects.

Information Technology Infrastructure Library version 4 (ITIL v.4) Foundation certification preferred.

Begleite führende Unternehmen der Life-Sciences-Branche bei ihrer digitalen Transformation – mit innovativen Lösungen im Bereich Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).
Deine Mission
Als Expert:in im Projektmanagement mit Spezialisierung auf Rockwell PharmaSuite verantwortest du die End-to-End-Umsetzung komplexer MES-Programme in einem stark regulierten Life-Sciences-Umfeld. Du steuerst globale Implementierungen, führst interdisziplinäre Teams und agierst als vertrauensvolle Ansprechperson für interne und externe Stakeholder.
Dabei verbindest du technische Exzellenz mit strategischem Weitblick: Du übernimmst die Projektsteuerung, führst dein Team zielgerichtet und trägst aktiv zur Geschäftsentwicklung bei – stets im Einklang mit den unternehmerischen Zielsetzungen und höchsten Qualitätsstandards.
Bei Accenture gestaltest du dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel. Und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen.
Aufgaben
Führungsverantwortung in MES-Projekten.
Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich die Durchführung von komplexen Rockwell PharmaSuite MES-Projekten – von der Planung bis zum Go-Live. Dabei leitest du Projekte und stellst die termingerechte, budgetkonforme Umsetzung im Einklang mit den Kundenanforderungen und Qualitätsstandards sicher.
Team & Zusammenarbeit.
Du übernimmst die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines wachsenden MES-Teams. Du übernimmst die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines wachsenden MES-Teams. Dabei förderst du aktiv die Weiterentwicklung deiner Kolleg:innen, stärkst durch gezieltes Mentoring den Teamzusammenhalt und stellst sicher, dass alle Teammitglieder ihre individuellen Stärken in die Projekte einbringen können.
Budgetierung, Qualität & Ressourcenplanung.
Du verantwortest die Projektbudgets sowie die Qualitätssicherung. Dabei steuerst du die Projektumsetzung effektiv und sorgst für das Erreichen der Ziele hinsichtlich Zeit, Kosten und Qualität. Zudem koordinierst du den effizienten Ressourceneinsatz deines Teams über mehrere parallel laufende Projekte hinweg und arbeitest eng mit Projektleitern sowie dem Senior Delivery Team zusammen.
Strategische Weiterentwicklung des Geschäftsbereichs.
Du arbeitest eng mit dem Leadership-Team zusammen, um die strategische Ausrichtung deines Geschäftsbereichs weiterzuentwickeln und dessen Wachstum gezielt voranzutreiben.
Presales & Kundenbeziehungsaufbau.
Du begleitest den Aufbau neuer Kundenbeziehungen aktiv – von der Angebotserstellung über die Mitwirkung bei RFP-Prozessen bis hin zu Verhandlungen mit Partnern und Stakeholdern. Damit trägst du zur Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und zur langfristigen Kundenbindung bei.
Qualifikation
Du hast jahrelange Berufserfahrung im Bereich Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) und fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Rockwell PharmaSuite – idealerweise in einer hochautomatisierten Produktionsumgebung der Life Sciences.
Du verfügst über umfassende Expertise in regulatorischen Anforderungen (FDA, GMP), im Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) sowie im technischen Supportumfeld.
Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung globaler Programme sowie in der Führung und Weiterentwicklung von Teams durch Mentoring und fachliche Unterstützung mit.
Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Erstellung von RFP-Antworten, SOWs und im Umgang mit Preismodellen.
Du bist eine erfahrene Ansprechperson für Kunden und interne Teams und überzeugst durch souveräne Kommunikation und Präsentationen – auf Deutsch (mindestens C1) und Englisch.
Du arbeitest kollaborativ, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert – und meisterst auch komplexe Herausforderungen mit Weitblick und Effizienz.
Dein fachlicher Hintergrund basiert auf einem erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Studium in Naturwissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.

Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied
Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Großartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst.

Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. Und mit einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie du dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und persönlich wachsen willst, liegt bei dir. Es ist deine Karriere. Wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst.

Clēnera is a tier-one developer and independent power producer located in Boise, Idaho, and is the U.S. subsidiary of Enlight Renewable Energy (Nasdaq: ENLT ). We develop, finance, construct, own, and operate utility-scale solar and energy storage facilities throughout the United States.

In its 2025 analysis of solar independent power producers, S&P Global ranked Clēnera as a top ten U.S. owner of planned installations in the next five years. Clēnera has over 1.9 GW of solar and 5.1 GWh of storage in operations or construction, and a development pipeline totaling 17.8 GW of solar and 51.1 GWh of storage across 23 states.

Our company culture is at the core of everything we do, so you’ll regularly find Caring, Committed, and Courageous individuals who value respectful, cross-functional collaboration with partners internally and externally. With our tremendous portfolio growth, we are increasing our headcount to meet the demands of the business.

Are you ready to change the world with us? ABOUT THE ROLE The HV & Commissioning Project Manager represents the Owner (IPP) and leads all high-voltage (HV), protection & controls (P&C), SCADA/communications, testing, and commissioning activities for utility-scale solar and energy storage assets.

This role owns cost, schedule, scope, quality, and risk for the HV build and commissioning phases from pre-functional checks through energization, interconnection testing, COD, and turnover to Operations.

Functions as the primary interface with utilities, Owner’s engineers, EPCs, testing/commissioning vendors, and internal stakeholders, ensuring systems are safe, compliant, utility-approved, and reliable for long-term operations.

WHAT YOU'LL DO Own end-to-end HV and site wide commissioning project planning and control, establishing the WBS, baseline schedule, cash flow forecasts, procurement milestones, and resource plans. Drive weekly schedule reviews, recovery planning, and critical path management with EPC and site leadership.

Lead HV and site wide commissioning cost management and forecasting, including monthly EAC/EVA updates, change order pricing validation, contingency management, pay application review/approval, and alignment of financial reporting with Project Controls and Finance.

Direct contract administration, ensuring scope clarity, deliverable compliance, and change management discipline; draft, negotiate, and recommend change orders and claims with clear schedule/cost impact analyses.

Coordinate cross-functional execution to ensure design completeness, permitting compliance, interconnection readiness, and QA/QC adherence. Execute risk management throughout the lifecycle, maintaining the risk register, quantifying impacts, implementing mitigations, and escalating strategic risks to senior leadership with recommended actions.

Drive site safety culture and compliance, integrating HSSE requirements into schedules and work plans and ensuring EPC adherence to safety KPIs and incident reporting.

Manage external stakeholder relationships, including utilities, AHJs, landowners, third party inspectors, and lenders’ engineers, ensuring timely reviews, approvals, and alignment on critical path items.

Produce executive ready reports and presentations, summarizing progress, risks, cash flow, and forecasted outcomes for internal leadership and, when applicable, board-level review. Mentor and guide other members of the project team, delegating workstreams, providing technical direction, and building execution discipline across the project team.

Lead lessons learned and continuous improvement, capturing insights during closeout and feeding back process and contract improvement recommendations to Construction leadership. Collaborate with individual departments, as well as cross-functionally with other departments within the organization.

Maintain organizational excellence in terms of project timelines and deliverables. Demonstrates the Clēnera Core Values of Caring, Committed, and Courageous. Other duties as assigned. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS Education: Bachelor’s degree in construction management, electrical engineering, , business, or related field experience.

Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in HV construction and commissioning project management. Minimum of 2 years of experience executing utility-scale renewable energy projects. Technology: Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, and an ability to learn company-specific software programs, tools, processes, and machines.

Skills/Attributes: Strong understanding of schedule and cost controls, including critical path analysis, recovery planning, earned value, EAC forecasting, and cash flow management.

Strong EPC contract administration and negotiation skills, capable of structuring clear change orders, resolving claims, and driving accountability to contractual obligations. Technical fluency in utility scale HV, construction, including civil works, MV/HV systems, SCADA, protection/controls, energy storage technology and commissioning sequences.

Adept at identifying systemic and emergent risks, quantifying impacts, and implementing mitigation actions that protect COD and budget objectives. Ability to build trust and effectively coordinate with utilities, AHJs, inspectors, lenders’ engineers, and EPC executives to clear critical path issues.

Clear, persuasive communication, producing concise, decision ready reporting for senior leadership and guiding the project team toward shared outcomes. Demonstrated ability to lead highly effective teams, both internally and externally.

Self-motivated to work through complex problems and competing priorities, including a high level of detail and organization. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Travel: 25% BENEFITS Clēnera pays 100% of employee and dependent premiums for a suite of medical, dental, and vision coverages.

Who We Are
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows.

More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity.

Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
The Role Addepar is looking for an experienced Enterprise SaaS Project Manager to help build the Global Project Management practice in the USA.

The Implementation Project Manager (IPM) will be responsible for the implementation of Addepar ’s Enterprise & Strategic clients, supporting a Cross-Functional team of both internal & client customers to deliver the Addepar solution on time/budget, and help build our team’s International/Global Implementation & Project Communication Processes as we continue to expand.

The IPM has business and solutions foresight and is an authority at translating and documenting broad goals and objectives into detailed project plans and processes to drive execution.

This is a strategic and highly visible role, with the IPM partnering with both external and internal teams, including Sales, Sales Engineering, Client Success & Account Management, Solutions Architecture, Data Solutions, Product, Engineering, and C-suites. Addepar takes a market-based approach to pay.

A successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for roles in Colorado, California, and New York.

The current range for this role is $118,00 - $148,00 (base salary) + bonus + equity + benefits. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

Identify and propose changes; change orders, and budget updates & determine impact and drive mitigation plans
Lead Steering Committee meetings with C-level partners & handle “difficult conversations”

Experience with waterfall & agile required

High-level familiarity with framework/operating models/goals of EMEA-based Wealth Management & Investment Advisory firms a plus
Understanding of project commercials including SOWs, budgeting, and resourcing
Professional experience in Financial Services, Technology Implementations, or Consulting preferred

Independent, adaptable and can thrive in a fast-paced environment

For a complex and business-critical transformation project, we are looking for an experienced Senior IT Project Manager on a freelance basis.
The project is currently entering an intensive stabilisation and recovery phase. The objective is to establish transparency regarding scope, responsibilities, dependencies and delivery status and to create a reliable basis for the successful continuation of the project.
The Senior IT Project Manager will assume the overall operational project leadership and will be responsible for steering the project through the stabilisation phase and towards the planned go-live.
Experience in complex, multi-vendor transformation projects and in the management of critical or challenging project situations is essential. Specific industry experience is not required.
Key Facts / Framework Conditions
Contract type: Freelance assignment
Start: As soon as possible
Duration: Expected until the planned go-live in May 2027
Workload: 100%
Working model: Hybrid
Location : Germany, Bonn
Onsite presence: Regular onsite presence will be required, particularly during the initial stabilisation phase
Languages: Fluent German and English are mandatory

Directs major RDT&E programs to support component and system-level CWMD/HDBT capability demonstrations and tests. Projects are key to supporting the Agency's efforts to develop new and improved methods of deterring adversary state-sponsored and terrorist infrastructure or, failing that, for putting it at risk.

Aids in formulating a coherent Division-level technology development and demonstration plan defining programs and projects that will support Directorate goals across the FYDP.

Recognizes opportunities for and develops programs with customers for new technologies and capabilities that are existing and/or available to the warfighter from the Tech Base, National Labs, and a variety of other sources.

Provides leadership to project managers and program managers in establishing and maintaining effective management processes and maintains a work environment conductive to effective integration of technical functions of planning, science, engineering, contracting, and resource management.

Develops required programmatic and fiscal documentation to support the planning, programming, budgeting, and execution system. Makes necessary programmatic and technical judgment of priorities. Provides a high degree of management and technical innovation to provide quality products that meet requirements at the lowest cost.
You may qualify at the GS-15, if you fulfill the following qualifications: One year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-14 grade level in the Federal service as listed below: Supervising and directing civilian and military Program Managers within a research, development, test and evaluation (RDT&E) portfolio, to include developing overarching strategies, defining objectives, nominating specific projects, and coordinating approved projects; Supervising senior civilian and military personnel, managing complex organizational budgets, and directing multidisciplinary technical teams in high-stakes environments; Overseeing complex RDT&E programs from conceptual research through operational test and evaluation, and leading the development, execution, and demonstration of non-kinetic, innovative operational technologies employed by Special Operation Forces (SOF) in the electronic warfare (EW), radio frequency (RF), or cyber domains; Operating along side uniform military service branches, with specialized expertise in military chain of command structures, integration of RDT&E capabilities, and administrative appraisal mechanisms (e.g.

s.h: So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess bei uns ab
s.t:
Schritt 1: Online Bewerbung
Reiche deine Bewerbungsunterlagen online über unser Jobportal ein. Damit wir deine Unterlagen weiterbearbeiten können, musst du ein Login erstellen. Nachdem du deine Bewerbung eingereicht hast, erhältst du eine Bestätigung. Wir beurteilen jede Bewerbung individuell anhand der Kriterien im Stelleninserat. Das braucht manchmal etwas Zeit. Wenn deine Bewerbung passt, kontaktieren wir dich für ein erstes Gespräch.
Schritt 2: Gespräche
Im Vorstellungsgespräch - telefonisch, vor Ort oder online - möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Wir überprüfen, ob deine Erwartungen an die Stelle mit unseren übereinstimmen, welche Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten du mitbringst, ob dich unsere Kultur anspricht und wie du ins Team passt. Bei beidseitigem Interesse und je nach Stelle finden mehrere Gespräche statt. Alle deine Fragen zur Stelle, zum Team oder zu den Anstellungsbedingungen sind immer willkommen.
Schritt 3: Weitere Schritte im Prozess
Je nach Stelle vereinbaren wir einen Probe- oder Schnuppertag, stellen dir eine fachliche Aufgabe, organisieren ein Treffen mit dem Team oder laden zu einem Assessment ein. In der Regel gehören auch Referenzauskünfte zu unserem Bewerbungsablauf. Über alle Schritte im Prozess wirst du transparent informiert.
Schritt 4: Bewerbungsentscheid
Du bist von uns überzeugt und wir von dir? Nach einer mündlichen Zusage erhältst du eine Bestätigung, die Vertragsunterlagen und Informationen, wie es bis zum Stellenantritt weitergeht. Es hat nicht geklappt? Wir freuen uns, wenn du dich trotz Absage auf andere spannende Stellen bewirbst.

A major function of the Office of Data Acquisitions is to provide databases developed from state highway safety related data for use in analyses aimed at reducing deaths, injuries, crashes, and medical costs.

As the Director, the incumbent will be responsible for the following: Advising the Associate Administrator on all matters related to the design, development, coordination, and management of crash investigation and data collection, and their contribution to achieving the mission of NHTSA.

Keeps the Associate Administrator fully informed as to the status of programs and of problems and controversial issues.

Collaborates closely with the Associate Administrator and other top officials of NHTSA to identify the agency's crash research and data needs, to determine techniques and methods by which the office can meet those needs, to estimate the cost and time required to meet the needs, and to determine other implications of changes.

Carrying out personnel management responsibilities for a staff of professional, technical, administrative and clerical support personnel. Makes decisions on work problems presented by subordinate supervisors and key specialists.

Evaluates performance of subordinate supervisors and reviews evaluations made by supervisors of subordinate employee's performance. Establishing policy and provides management oversight of the State Data Reporting Systems Division responsible for the crash record-based data.

Crash record based data includes the Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS), a fundamental national data base on traffic safety, Crash Report Sampling System (CRSS), Not-in-Traffic System (NTS) and the State Electronic Data Collection Program (SEDC)., The Division also provides the expertise in sample design and quality control to the other offices in the National Center for Statistics and Analysis, the rest of NHTSA and other offices in DOT.

Establishing policy and provides management oversight of the Crash Investigation Division (CID), provides executive leadership in the planning, design, development, coordination, and management of national networks of motor vehicle traffic crash research and data collection activities.

These include the operation of a national system to conduct detailed investigations of a well-defined selection of motor vehicle crashes currently the Crash Investigation Sampling System (CISS)); and the Special Crash Investigations (SCI) program of special investigations of crashes of particular, interest; and Systems for collecting, supplementing, and coding data from police crash reports to provide special purpose data files.

Maintaining liaison with other Federal agencies, State and local governments, police agencies, hospitals, private safety groups, motor vehicle and equipment manufacturers, crash research and analysis organizations, professional societies, and other groups with an interest in crash investigation and crash data for the purposes are for exchanging crash data and information on crash research technology, encouraging the use of crash data, and cooperating on crash research programs.

The ideal candidate is a data executive and systems expert with a track record of managing federal data collection, automation, and national crash investigation programs.

They possess the strategic and technical skills to lead multi-disciplinary teams while directing the human resource, budgetary, and procurement parameters vital to national highway safety initiatives.

A skilled collaborator, they excel at building partnerships across federal, state, and private sectors including law enforcement, public health, and the automotive industry to secure cooperation and advance data systems.

Furthermore, they bring expertise in data governance, enforcing quality control and data completeness while protecting individual privacy, ensuring the delivery of accurate databases that support national safety research and rulemaking.
To meet the minimum qualifications for this position, you must meet the specialized experience qualifications.

To qualify for the Grade 15, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equal or equivalent to the GS-14, it must include: Experience directing multi-disciplinary professional, technical, and administrative teams while managing the organizational, human resource, and budgetary parameters vital to national highway traffic safety initiatives.

Experience communicating with system managers, rulemaking engineers, researchers, technicians, traffic safety administrators, Governor's Representatives for Highway Safety, State and local officials, national data system program managers and others associated with the application of data as it applies to helping solve complex safety issues.

Experience establishing policy and overseeing large federal data divisions to ensure data completeness, security, and rigorous quality control. Examples include working with executive leadership to plan, develop, and manage large-scale national data collection systems and multi-level crash investigation programs.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES (KSAs): Your qualifications will be evaluated on the basis of your level of knowledge, skills, abilities and/or competencies in the following areas: Technical Knowledge: Knowledge of federal budgeting to manage large divisional funds, appropriations, large-scale national data architecture, data collection methodologies, complex procurement or contracting mechanisms and systems engineering principles required to build and sustain nationwide databases.

Leadership and Supervision: Management and/or team leader skills, including the ability to direct, manage, and develop a diverse, high-performing human resources workforce of technical and administrative staff.

Communication: Communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, including the ability to secure community support, build strategic intergovernmental alliances, and establish private-sector data-sharing partnerships.

Reasoning: Ability to collaborate across federal, state, and private boundaries to improve data accessibility while balancing competing stakeholder priorities.

For all types of consideration, experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

# Manager:in digitale Kanäle 80 - 100% #
Suchst du eine Herausforderung im Umfeld von Politik und Verwaltung, am digitalen Puls der Zeit, bei einer Arbeitgeberin mit Themen so vielfältig wie das Leben?
Die Direktion der Justiz und des Innern (JI) erfüllt eine Vielfalt von Aufgaben, von A wie Archivwesen bis Z wie Zivilstandswesen. Bei uns im Generalsekretariat laufen die Fäden zusammen. Wir unterstützen die Direktionsvorsteherin und unsere Einheiten, bearbeiten Querschnittsthemen und begleiten und führen Programme und Projekte.
Im Januar 2027 tritt das revidierte Verwaltungsrechtspflegegesetz in Kraft, das vorsieht, dass Verwaltungsverfahren neu auch digital über spezielle elektronische Kanäle abgewickelt werden. Mit RRB Nr. 433/2026 wurde ein wichtiger Meilenstein für die Implementierung dieser elektronischen Kanäle im Kanton Zürich erreicht: Im Projekt VRGo wird die neue technische Lösung «VerfahrenZH» aufgebaut, welche die rechtskonforme Abwicklung von Verwaltungsverfahren ermöglicht.
Um den organisationsübergreifenden Aufbau dieser Lösung seitens der JI zu begleiten, und um im Betrieb der Lösung die Anforderungen unserer Verwaltungseinheiten fachgerecht bei den zuständigen Stellen einzubringen, suchen wir per 1. Oktober 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung im Generalsekretariat eine Person mit technischem Hintergrund als Manager/in digitale Kanäle (80 - 100 %).
### Deine Hauptaufgaben ###
* Du stehst proaktiv im Austausch mit den verfahrensführenden Stellen der JI und identifizierst, koordinierst und priorisierst ihre Anforderungen an die elektronischen Kanäle. Diese bringst du in die Projekte zu deren Weiterentwicklung und in übergreifende Digitalisierungsvorhaben ein.
* Du kennst die relevanten Fachapplikationen der JI und unterstützt allfällige Weiterentwicklungen und Anbindungen in Zusammenhang mit den elektronischen Kanälen.
* Du bist in der JI, im Kanton und im Bund mit den relevanten Stellen vernetzt und über bedeutsame Entwicklungen auf dem Laufenden.
* Du berätst und unterstützt die Verwaltungseinheiten der JI bei der weiteren Digitalisierung ihrer Verwaltungsverfahren. Dazu begleitest du die Umsetzung neuer oder weiterentwickelter Funktionalitäten aus Nutzendensicht und stehst in engem Austausch mit den Fachbereichen, Legal, IT-/Betriebsteams und weiteren Stakeholdern.
### Dein Profil ###
* Tertiäre Ausbildung (z.B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Rechtswissenschaften), mit Erfahrung in der Digitalisierung von Prozessen, Dienstleistungen oder Kommunikationskanälen (vorzugsweise in der Verwaltung oder im juristischen Bereich)
* Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse der Nutzenden sowie für serviceorientierte Gestaltung, stark in Koordination und Stakeholder-Management
* Schnelle Auffassungsgabe sowie eine analytische, strukturierte und konzeptionelle Arbeitsweise mit Freude an der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung digitaler Lösungen
* Ganzheitliches Denken, hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative und hohe Eigenverantwortung mit proaktivem Arbeitsverständnis
### Unser Angebot ###
* Eine vielseitige und sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem motivierten Team
* Gelebte flache Hierarchien und flexible Home-Office-Regelungen
* Spannende Einblicke in die vielseitigen Tätigkeiten unserer Einheiten
* Ein Arbeitsort direkt am Hauptbahnhof
* Die Stelle ist in Lohnklasse 20 eingereiht (Informationen zum Lohnsystem).
### Bewerbung ###
Schick uns deine Bewerbung direkt über unser Online-Tool (für diese Stelle berücksichtigen wir keine Bewerbungen über Personaldienstleistungsunternehmen). Bei Fragen zur Stelle kannst du dich gerne an Samuel Klaus, Leiter Recht Digital, wenden (043 259 25 43, samuel.klaus@ji.zh.ch).

## Introduction de la société ##
Comadur SA, Leader mondial de la production de composants en matériaux durs Swiss Made. Nous faisons partie du Swatch Group, premier fabricant mondial de produits horlogers. Reconnus comme étant le partenaire privilégié des marques du Groupe pour la production de Céramiques, Glaces saphir et Pierres d-horlogerie destinés à l-industrie horlogère.
Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous proposons, sur notre site de Boncourt, un poste de :
**Chef de projet Industrialisation H/F**
Votre engagement contribuera à notre essor tout autant qu-à votre développement personnel à travers :
* Un espace de travail moderne et agréable.
* Des conditions sociales de premier ordre.
* Une équipe dynamique, exigeante, à l-écoute et toujours en quête de nouveaux défis.
* Une volonté commune : collaborer et grandir ensemble pour devenir un partenaire incontournable.
## Description du poste ##
* Manager et être l-acteur principal de plusieurs projets d-industrialisation, d'un point de vue technique et administratif :
* En phase d-étude : recherche de solutions, plans d-expérience sur le terrain, rédaction de rapports d-essais, rédaction de cahiers des charges, appels d-offres, comparatifs, choix de solutions techniques, montage administratif de dossiers d-investissement.
* En phase de réalisation : suivi fabrication chez les fournisseurs, essais et mises au point machines, formation et transmission à la production.
* Recherche et développement de procédés de fabrication innovants et industrialisables pour la fabrication de composants en matériaux durs.
* Etre garant de la stabilité et de la fiabilité technique des équipements et procédés mis en place.
* Soutien à la production en termes de résolution de problèmes et d-amélioration continue.
## Profil ##
* Vous êtes titulaire d-un diplôme «Ingénieur HES» ou «Technicien ET».
* Vous êtes pluridisciplinaire et expérimenté : mécanique, automatisation, procédés, fortement intéressé à la fois par l-automation et les procédés spécifiques aux matériaux durs.
* Vous avez de l-expérience dans le suivi de projets industriels (automatisation + procédés de fabrication).
* Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques courants et de langue maternelle française, ainsi que bonnes connaissances d-anglais et d-allemand.
* Vous êtes flexible au niveau des déplacements sur les différents sites de l-entreprise.
* Vous êtes doté d-une personnalité technique, résistante, constructive, proactive, communicative et structurée.
## Compétences requises ##
Nous recherchons une personne organisée, capable de travailler en multitâches avec d-excellentes qualités relationnelles tant avec les interlocuteurs externes et internes.
Dotée d-une bonne ouverture d-esprit, de créativité et de dynamisme, sachant prendre du recul et être à l-écoute.
## Langues ##
Français, l'anglais est un atout.
